name: Alexander Robinson's store or trading-house at Wolf Point
trade: the country trade at the forks — a store or trading-house

proprietors.name: Alexander Robinson (Che-che-pin-qua)
proprietors.basis: Andreas names the house and its keeper in one sentence: 'During the latter part of his residence in Chicago, he lived at Wolf Point, where he had a store or trading-house.' The county clerk's 1831 permits to sell goods — to Alexander Robinson, John B. Beaubien and Madore B. Beaubien — and the tavern licence of 8 June 1830 stand behind it, and the resident layer already reads his occupation as trader at the same citation. What no source gives is a date this house opened or closed, which is why only the keeper is attested here.

locations.basis: Wolf Point is where Andreas puts the house, and robinson_caldwell_cabins is the only Wolf Point building this dataset attaches to him — the household's own works_at reads the same structure at the same tier and for the same reason. Whether the store was one of the cabins or a separate building beside them is not stated, so the premises is inferred and no street face is claimed: Wolf Point in 1835 is a place at the forks, not an address on a platted corridor.

dates.basis: No source dates this house at either end. Andreas places it in 'the latter part of his residence in Chicago', which is a position in a life and not a year, and Wau-Bun's cabins at Wolf Point describe 1831. The record carries no date it cannot read.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read metis: Alexander Robinson (Che-che-pin-qua) (metis). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A reading that dates this house at either end, names its premises apart from the cabins, or names anybody who worked in it. REVIEW REQUIRED: the household and the structure this record stands on both carry it, on AGENTS.md's Indigenous-history standard, and a record of a Métis-run house six weeks before the removal does not carry less.
